Tests the {@link LoopingListIterator} class.

Many tests track the iterator's logical position with a trailing comment that shows the list contents and marks the element the cursor sits before with angle brackets. For example, the comment {@code // a c} means the list holds {@code [a, b, c]} and a call to {@code next()} would return {@code b} while a call to {@code previous()} would return {@code a}.
Repeat the exercise, this time inserting while walking backward.
